warnings.headline: A slow-moving band of heavy rain may cause some flooding and transport disruption, particularly across south Devon and south Cornwall.
warnings.description:
A band of rain will become slow-moving across southwest England during Sunday, before clearing on Sunday night. Rainfall totals of 20-40 mm are likely quite widely, with 50-70 mm over higher ground. There remains a chance of heavier and more persistent rain developing, which could bring 60-80 mm to some lower-lying areas too, particularly Torbay, South Hams and south Cornwall, and around 100 mm over Dartmoor.

For further details see https://www.metoffice.gov.uk/weather/warnings-and-advice/uk-warnings

warnings.event: Flood Warning: South Devon coast at Beesands, Torcross, Slapton and Dawlish
warnings.headline: Flooding is expected: South Devon coast at Beesands, Torcross, Slapton and Dawlish
warnings.description:
High tides, strong winds and large waves are expected to cause flooding tomorrow. 

Flooding is expected 3 hours either side of high tides 

Areas at risk include exposed coastal areas at Hallsands, Beesands, Torcross, Slapton, Blackpool Sands, Teignmouth Promenade and Dawlish. The high tide at Teignmouth on Sunday morning is at 04:15. Forecast total high tide level is 2.14mAOD, which is 0.56 metres above tide table level. Strong force 6 South Easterly winds and offshore wave heights of over 2.1m are forecast over the high tide.
